def _event_schedule(event, user, next_run):
    s = ScheduledEventExport.objects.create(
        event=event,
        owner=user,
        export_identifier='orderlist',
        export_form_data={'_format': 'xlsx', 'date_range': 'year_this'},
        locale='en',
        mail_additional_recipients='foo@example.org',
        mail_subject='Current order list',
        mail_template='Here is the current order list',
        schedule_rrule='DTSTART:20230118T000000\nRRULE:FREQ=DAILY',
        schedule_rrule_time=time(3, 30),
    )
    ScheduledEventExport.objects.filter(pk=s.pk).update(schedule_next_run=next_run)
    return s


def _organizer_schedule(organizer, user, next_run):
    s = ScheduledOrganizerExport.objects.create(
        organizer=organizer,
        timezone='Europe/Berlin',
        owner=user,
        export_identifier='eventdata',
        export_form_data={'_format': 'default', 'all_events': True},
        locale='en',
        mail_additional_recipients='foo@example.org',
        mail_subject='Event data',
        mail_template='Here is the event data',
        schedule_rrule='DTSTART:20230118T000000\nRRULE:FREQ=DAILY',
        schedule_rrule_time=time(3, 30),
    )
    ScheduledOrganizerExport.objects.filter(pk=s.pk).update(schedule_next_run=next_run)
    return s


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_run_scheduled_exports_dispatches_due_event_export(event, user):
    s = _event_schedule(event, user, next_run=now() - timedelta(minutes=1))
    with mock.patch('pretix.base.services.export.scheduled_event_export.apply_async') as apply_async, \
            mock.patch('pretix.base.services.export.scheduled_organizer_export.apply_async') as apply_async_orga:
        run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)
    apply_async.assert_called_once_with(kwargs={'event': event.pk, 'schedule': s.pk})
    apply_async_orga.assert_not_called()
    s.refresh_from_db()
    assert s.schedule_next_run > now()


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_run_scheduled_exports_dispatches_due_organizer_export(event, user):
    s = _organizer_schedule(event.organizer, user, next_run=now() - timedelta(minutes=1))
    with mock.patch('pretix.base.services.export.scheduled_event_export.apply_async') as apply_async, \
            mock.patch('pretix.base.services.export.scheduled_organizer_export.apply_async') as apply_async_orga:
        run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)
    apply_async.assert_not_called()
    apply_async_orga.assert_called_once_with(kwargs={'organizer': event.organizer.pk, 'schedule': s.pk})
    s.refresh_from_db()
    assert s.schedule_next_run > now()


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_run_scheduled_exports_skips_exports_not_yet_due(event, user):
    next_run = now() + timedelta(hours=2)
    s = _event_schedule(event, user, next_run=next_run)
    o = _organizer_schedule(event.organizer, user, next_run=None)
    with mock.patch('pretix.base.services.export.scheduled_event_export.apply_async') as apply_async, \
            mock.patch('pretix.base.services.export.scheduled_organizer_export.apply_async') as apply_async_orga:
        run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)
    apply_async.assert_not_called()
    apply_async_orga.assert_not_called()
    s.refresh_from_db()
    o.refresh_from_db()
    assert s.schedule_next_run == next_run
    assert o.schedule_next_run is None


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_run_scheduled_exports_does_not_dispatch_twice(event, user):
    s = _event_schedule(event, user, next_run=now() - timedelta(minutes=1))
    with mock.patch('pretix.base.services.export.scheduled_event_export.apply_async') as apply_async:
        run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)
        run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)
    apply_async.assert_called_once_with(kwargs={'event': event.pk, 'schedule': s.pk})


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_run_scheduled_exports_sends_event_export_by_mail(event, user):
    s = _event_schedule(event, user, next_run=now() - timedelta(minutes=1))
    with override_settings(EMAIL_BACKEND='django.core.mail.backends.locmem.EmailBackend'):
        djmail.outbox = []
        run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 1
    assert djmail.outbox[0].subject == 'Current order list'
    assert djmail.outbox[0].to == [user.email]
    assert djmail.outbox[0].cc == []
    assert djmail.outbox[0].bcc == []
    assert djmail.outbox[0].attachments
    s.refresh_from_db()
    assert s.error_counter == 0
    assert s.schedule_next_run > now()


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_run_scheduled_exports_sends_organizer_export_by_mail(event, user):
    _organizer_schedule(event.organizer, user, next_run=now() - timedelta(minutes=1))
    with override_settings(EMAIL_BACKEND='django.core.mail.backends.locmem.EmailBackend'):
        djmail.outbox = []
        run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)
    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 1
    assert djmail.outbox[0].subject == 'Event data'
    assert djmail.outbox[0].to == ['foo@example.org']
    assert djmail.outbox[0].cc == [user.email]
    assert djmail.outbox[0].attachments
